mission.goal: Complete CIOS as a secured, observable, durable and recoverable live production service without treating source admission as the terminal boundary.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane and authorised Federation Omega operators
mission.workflow: Admit exact source, build digest-pinned images, upgrade the allowlisted operator, verify managed PostgreSQL recovery controls, deploy CIOS at zero traffic, run semantic and idempotency canaries, restore the baseline traffic map, re-run the recovery canary and promote only the exact proven revision.
mission.data: Tenant-scoped capital-intelligence events and bounded provider receipts; credentials remain Secret Manager references and are never returned.
mission.interface: Authenticated four-route CIOS provider runtime plus an authenticated Federation Omega operator control lane.
mission.stack: Python 3.12, Psycopg 3 pooled PostgreSQL, Node.js 20 Federation operator, Google Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, Cloud Build and GitHub Actions WIF.
mission.environment: Deterministic local admission followed by exact-main provider execution through the existing sovereign Google Cloud estate.
mission.governance: Formation-gated reversible source build; live build, deployment, rollback and promotion require separate current permits and real provider authority.
mission.failure: Fail closed on source, target, digest, tenant, identity, secret-name, backup, PITR, traffic, receipt, semantic, audit-chain or idempotency drift.
mission.testing: Complete CIOS regression court, rc8 persistence/operator admission, 64-way SQLite reference containment, Node contract/adapter tests, syntax checks and exact-head CI.
mission.deployment: Source lane implemented but not self-certified live; .github/workflows/cios-production-lane.yml executes the provider lane only from main with keyless WIF and the exact confirmation gate.
mission.continuity: Immutable GCS operation receipts bind deployment, canary, rollback and promotion to one source SHA, image digest, Cloud Run revision and baseline traffic fingerprint.

assumptions.stack: The admitted CIOS domain engines remain reusable behind the new persistence seam.
assumptions.runtime: Python 3.12 and Node.js 20 are available in the build and runtime images.
assumptions.storage: Production uses distinct state and audit PostgreSQL URLs, a bounded connection pool and provider-native backup/PITR controls.
assumptions.authentication: Cloud Run IAM identity occupies Authorization while X-CIOS-Token carries the application secret; fixed tenant and runtime user bindings remain server-side.
assumptions.deployment: The existing Artifact Registry, control bucket, Cloud SQL instance, Secret Manager secrets, service identities and WIF route must pass fresh provider readback.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: provider API and control-plane lane only.
components.backend: Fail-closed Python provider runtime and exact-action Federation Omega operator.
components.database: Psycopg 3 pooled PostgreSQL state adapter with advisory-locked migrations, atomic transactions, tenant isolation and idempotency.
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: no asynchronous effect queue is enabled.
components.worker: Cloud Run instances bounded to eight concurrent requests and sixteen or fewer database connections per process.
components.scheduler: GitHub Actions dispatch is the external execution lane; no autonomous financial task is introduced.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: promotion is receipt- and provider-readback-bound.
components.storage: Separate PostgreSQL audit database with a hash chain and database triggers rejecting UPDATE and DELETE; immutable control receipts use generation-match-zero GCS writes.
components.authentication: Cloud Run IAM identity, Secret Manager application token, exact service identity and constant-time token validation.

observability.correlation_ids: Source SHA, deploymentKey, canaryKey, revision, event ID and receipt digest.
observability.health_checks: Authenticated semantic /health and /ready plus TCP startup/liveness probes compatible with Cloud Run.
observability.structured_logs: Cloud Run request logs and JSON operator receipts exclude secret values.
observability.audit_logs: Separate append-only PostgreSQL hash chain plus provider-native Cloud Audit Logs.
observability.metrics_alerts: Cloud Run readiness/traffic, Cloud SQL backup/PITR and canary outcomes gate promotion.

testing.unit: CIOS domain, persistence configuration, migration, authentication, tenancy, authority, ingestion and release suites.
testing.integration: Real local HTTP canary, serialized SQLite reference concurrency, PostgreSQL contract fakes and operator-to-adapter action routing.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Digest-bound zero-traffic deploy, semantic event/replay, baseline rollback, recovery canary and separately gated promotion in the provider workflow.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Synthetic tenants, events, Cloud Run services, traffic maps, Cloud SQL controls and immutable receipt bindings.
testing.failure_first: Mutable image tags, target drift, same state/audit URL, oversized pools, missing backups/PITR, receipt collision, semantic mismatch, secret disclosure and promotion without canary/rollback are rejected.

deploy_commands: Dispatch CIOS Production Lane from the exact admitted main SHA with phase full-prove-and-rollback, then full-promote only after all receipts pass.
rollback_commands: Invoke ROLLBACK_CIOS_TRAFFIC with the exact deployment receipt binding; the operator restores the baseline active traffic map and retains the candidate only at its zero-traffic tag.
delivery.debugging: Inspect the exact contract error, source SHA, digest, revision, traffic fingerprint and immutable receipt; never retry an execution-uncertain mutation with a different idempotency key.

watchman.health: Local source canary gates are green; provider execution remains separately evidence-bound until fresh live receipts exist.
watchman.rollback: Restore the deployment receipt's baseline traffic targets and verify the candidate remains at zero traffic for a recovery canary.

continuity.idempotency: Events, deployments and canaries require collision-safe keys; control receipts are immutable first-writer-wins objects.
continuity.checkpoints: Exact Git SHA, test receipt, image digest, Cloud SQL recovery readback, prior traffic fingerprint, revision, canary, rollback, recovery and promotion receipts.
continuity.resume_conditions: Exact main SHA, live v4 operator allowlist, trusted provider identity, managed persistence controls and complete source admission are freshly verified.
continuity.stop_switch: CIOS_PROMOTION_ENABLED must be true and the exact deployment, canary and rollback receipts must converge; otherwise promotion is denied.

proof.test_results: Local rc8 targeted Python and Node courts passed before full-repository admission; exact counts and GitHub exact-head results are bound later in the admission receipt.
proof.deployment_readback: WITHHELD: source cannot self-certify a live provider outcome.
proof.semantic_verification: Local tests prove configuration, migration, append-only, token separation, digest pinning, zero-traffic, backup/PITR, canary, receipt, rollback and promotion contracts with provider fakes.
unresolved_defects: Fresh provider-native execution, independent Cloud SQL restore evidence, promoted traffic and monitoring receipts remain required before production_claim may become true.
Document routes remain disabled until malware/DLP and resource-isolated parsing are independently qualified.
SBOM, signature and vulnerability-provider receipts remain a release-admission requirement for a live promotion.

builds.scope: managed PostgreSQL state, migrations and bounded pools
separate append-only PostgreSQL audit and immutable receipts
v4 provider operator and zero-traffic canary/rollback/recovery/promotion lane
fresh live deployment, recovery, promotion and production receipt
